ASUS TUF Gaming A15 FA506NCG-HN807W Gaming Laptop (AMD Ryzen 7 7445HS / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 4GB / 144Hz FHD Display / Windows 11 Home Edition)

Geared for serious gaming and real-world durability, the ASUS TUF Gaming A15 FA506NCG-HN807W is a fully-loaded gaming laptop engineered to lead you to victory, now available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Powered by the efficient AMD Ryzen 7 7445HS processor core, this machine handles intensive streaming and heavy multitasking layouts with seamless fluid stability. Graphics run smooth with the dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 4GB GDDR6 laptop GPU matrix, delivering high frame rates for modern popular competitive titles. The fast 144Hz Full HD IPS-level nano-edge display panel keeps gameplay fluid while reducing motion blur tracking. Adhering to strict MIL-STD-810H military-grade endurance criteria, its durable chassis is backed by a comprehensive anti-dust dual fan self-cleaning thermal cooling ecosystem layout. Complete with pre-installed genuine Windows 11 Home edition, a gaming-optimized RGB backlit keyboard architecture, and immersive DTS:X Ultra high-fidelity acoustics technology, this TUF laptop framework is built to endure high-performance operations.
